name: complaint-management-system
description: MERN stack complaint management system for residential communities

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n db,api,web -c magenta,blue,green "npm run db --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.dev:app: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
